what: the research version of followed_poles with its modal fit on the synthetic 4 x 3 identification of m7d_parity.json case 0 (its known delay as the block delay; transport 0, tracker delay factor 0.625, tracking 10 % to 100 Hz, update 0.01 s, the reference given, phases specified, level 1), run on a quasi-steady loop: the plant moved from the identification, read through two one-pole stages at the tracking bandwidth. Per update: f, hold (e engage, f free), the drive in force is scale times the last answer (zero at engage), controls, the answer, values (gain, error_db, gated, near_modes, shift_bw, damping_change, prediction_ratio), the followed fr and zr after it. Arrays are little-endian float64 in base64, row-major.

cases.name: follow: the modes 0.6 % low, a cap at updates 150 to 155
gate: the modes 1.5 % high and lighter, a 20-update window, gate at 1.2
